name: Dystopia
summary:
Dystopia is a free-to-play VR rhythm game where you slice glowing crystals to the beat of the music as they fly towards you. With a blade in each hand, cut each crystal the way its arrow points.

You are always slicing to new music, fresh every session. Hear a song you love? Save it to your Archive to replay exactly as it played, because once it finishes it is gone for good. Go from Easy to Insane and unlock new artifact worlds as you slice.

Five stations, each with its own sound: metal on Mental, EDM on P
